title: 古书
note: 30 秒样片 = 一条一镜到底（EP001_ONE），0 次切镜，24 个时间切片，20 次攻防。切镜是拖节奏的元凶，镜头黏在两人身上不放。
era_en: Japanese cel-shaded anime, bold black outlines, two-step hard shading, high contrast

cast_en.雷昂: a man in his early thirties, square jaw, a diagonal scar running from his left brow ridge down across his cheekbone, dark grey hair falling to his jawline and swept back with two strands hanging over his eyebrows, a sleeveless dark brown leather chest guard with three horizontal straps, a single iron pauldron on his left shoulder with a notch in its rim, his right arm wrapped from shoulder to wrist in dark cloth, dark grey trousers with calf wraps
cast_en.艾琳: a woman of twenty-eight, oval face with a small mole under her right eye, pale blonde hair in a high ponytail tied high at the back of her head falling to her shoulder blades with one loose strand in front of her left ear, a dark blue high-collared robe with a column of seven round silver buttons from collar to waist, wide sleeves lined in silver-grey, a wide leather belt with three small pouches at her left hip
cast_en.凯尔: a teenage boy with short brown hair and a plain grey tunic, holding a thick book shut with a copper clasp against his chest

loc_en.LOC-神殿: the interior of an abandoned stone temple at night, tall broken columns along both sides, moonlight falling through a crack in the domed ceiling, loose rubble scattered across the flagstone floor, cool blue moonlight from above as the single light source

shots.beat: 决斗（狂化三档 · 巨型技能）
shots.intent: 狂化做成**三档递进**，每档换资产：常态 0–10s、H1 10–21s、H2 21–30s。上一稿只在 24 秒写了一句形容词，两个狂化资产一次都没进 uses —— 狂化是这个角色的核心机制，不能当形容词用。技能全面巨大化：剑气横跨全殿、法阵铺满地面、冰棱两人高、光矛粗如石柱、地裂从这头到那头。每次命中按日式动画爆炸三层写：白热核 → 饱和冲击波环 → 碎屑速度线。

cast.name: 艾琳
cast.state: 远程压制 + 旋杖近战格挡反打

cast.name: 凯尔
cast.state: 柱后抱书，第 20 秒被冲击波扫过

forms.cn: H1：虹膜赤红、眼白血丝、右臂黑纹到肘
H2：眼球全红、黑纹到锁骨、呼气白雾、剑身化红光柱

location.desc: 镜头在大殿里连续飞行

shots.camera_cn: 10 条飞行路径覆盖 30 秒
shots.transition_cn: 0 次切镜。30 个逐秒切片里**只有 5 个带运镜**，而且每条都写成「同一条运动的延续」—— 实测切点数跟着运镜指令条数走：11 条→9 刀，7 条→0 刀

action.beat: 横跨全殿剑气→残影突进 vs 旋杖近战→H1→冰墙→光矛对撞→巨型法阵→H2 十二连斩
action.end: 腾空通天落石对横杖，冲击波扫过全场，内层裂缝，定格

lines.speaker: 雷昂
lines.text: 书里最后一页能解我妹妹的咒。

lines.speaker: 艾琳
lines.text: 翻开它，死的就不止你妹妹。

shots.sound: 钢铁交击、剑气破空、冰墙崩塌、光矛爆炸、石板掀飞，全程无空档
shots.continuity_out: 两人僵持，内层裂一道缝

fail_if: 画面里出现烧录的文字
任何一秒里两人停下不动
狂化三档看起来是三个人（脸必须一致）
技能范围缩水成小特效

render.sound_en: continuous clashes of steel, crescents of energy tearing the air, a wall of ice collapsing, light lances detonating and slabs of stone blowing apart, running through the whole take over a low hall echo

beats_en.action: the red-haired swordsman in red-and-black armour with the huge red-edged greatsword stands at one end of the hall and the blonde woman in the dark blue robe with the ringed staff at the other; she sweeps the staff through a full circle and the ring flares white-hot as the first four electric-blue rhombic bolts leave it
beats_en.cn: 俯冲进场｜她杖划整圈，银环白热炸开，前 4 发电蓝光弹出膛
beats_en.move: the take opens as one single unbroken camera flight that runs for the whole thirty seconds: it dives the length of the hall at knee height, banks around her and swings across to fly beside him
beats_en.size: a moving shot that stays with the fight

beats_en.action: eight more bolts fan out behind the first four so twelve long comet tails of blue-white light rake down both rows of columns and throw moving shadows across the walls, and he breaks into a run straight into the spread
beats_en.cn: 再射 8 发｜12 条青白彗尾扫过两排石柱，墙上投出跑动的阴影｜他迎着弹幕冲

beats_en.action: he turns the flat of the blade into three bolts in succession and each one goes off against the steel with a frame of blown-out white at the core, then a saturated shockwave ring spreading outward, then debris and speed lines flying off
beats_en.cn: 剑面连磕 3 发，每一发都是白热核→蓝色冲击波环→碎光四散

beats_en.action: he rolls under two more and comes up cutting, splitting two bolts in the air so they burst into wide sprays of blue shards while he keeps closing
beats_en.cn: 侧滚 2 发｜起身斩碎 2 发，炸成大片蓝色碎晶

beats_en.action: he drops his shoulder and drags the greatsword back low behind him as the black lines on his right arm blaze orange-red and the blood groove floods with white-hot light from hilt to tip
beats_en.cn: 越肩升起｜**他沉肩、把巨剑往身后低低拖开蓄力**，右臂黑纹亮成橙红，血槽从柄到尖灌满白热光

beats_en.action: he swings and a crescent of white-cored crimson light as wide as the whole hall leaves the sword, tearing a trench across the flagstones and shearing chunks off the columns on both sides as it travels
beats_en.cn: **剑气斩·横跨全殿**：新月弧宽及整个大殿，白热核+炽红边，地面犁出深沟，两侧石柱被削掉大块

beats_en.action: the crescent slams into a pale blue hexagonal lattice she throws up in front of her with a frame of blown-out white at the core, then a saturated shockwave ring spreading outward, then debris and speed lines flying off, and the outer layer breaks apart into a cloud of drifting light
beats_en.cn: 她抛袖三印，六边形光纹成形｜剑气命中：白热核→蓝色冲击波环→**外层碎**成光云

beats_en.action: she gives ground two steps under the pressure and the wash of light throws her shadow long across the floor behind her
beats_en.cn: 她被压得退两步，光把她的影子在地上拉得很长

beats_en.action: he stamps once and crosses the remaining ground with three fading afterimages strung out behind him, each one edged in orange-red light
beats_en.cn: 急推跟进｜残影突进：三道橙红描边的残影拖在身后
beats_en.move: the same unbroken flight now carries the camera forward with him and around the pair, orbiting them and staying in motion the whole way round
beats_en.size: a moving shot that stays with the fight

beats_en.action: he opens with a flat horizontal swing and she spins the staff in front of her and turns it aside in a blur of shaft, sparks raking off the contact
beats_en.cn: 狂澜①横挥 → **她旋杖格开**，接触点刮出火星带

beats_en.action: his irises turn crimson and blood threads spread across the whites of his eyes, and black lines climb out from under the wrappings on his right arm as far as the elbow; he follows with a spinning reverse cut and an overhead chop, and she turns the first aside and takes the second square on the shaft with both hands
beats_en.cn: 推眼睛再拉开｜**狂化 H1**：虹膜转赤红、眼白布血丝、右臂黑纹爬到肘｜狂澜②③ → 她旋杖格+双手硬接

beats_en.action: she snaps the butt of the staff up under his blade and lifts it off line so his swing goes wide over her shoulder and cuts a gouge out of the column behind her
beats_en.cn: **杖尾上挑**把剑挑离轨道，他劈空，一刀在她身后的石柱上砍出大缺口

beats_en.action: she steps through him in a flash of blue light, appears at his back and sweeps the shaft across at him
beats_en.cn: **闪身背刺**：蓝光一闪到他背后，杖身横扫

beats_en.action: he turns the shaft away with the iron pauldron and counters, and the edge takes one strand of blonde hair from beside her ear
beats_en.cn: 他护肩架开反手一斩，剑锋削落她耳侧一缕金发

beats_en.action: she drives the staff tip into the flagstones and a blue hexagonal field floods outward and covers the entire floor of the hall in a glowing lattice
beats_en.cn: 降到地面｜**静水领域铺满整个大殿地面**，整块地在发光
beats_en.move: still the same unbroken flight, the camera sinks to floor level, threads forward between the rising shapes and cranes back up with her
beats_en.size: a moving shot that stays with the fight

beats_en.action: she pushes the staff head forward and twelve columns of glowing blue ice erupt out of that field between them, each one twice the height of a man, locking together into a wall across the hall while he skids to a stop in front of it
beats_en.cn: **她推杖催阵** → 12 根发光冰棱破地而起结成冰墙｜**他急刹在墙前**

beats_en.action: he goes straight at the wall and six heavy swings shatter six columns, each break throwing a frame of blown-out white at the core, then a saturated shockwave ring spreading outward, then debris and speed lines flying off
beats_en.cn: 六记重斩碎 6 根，每一根都是白热核→蓝冲击环→冰片暴风

beats_en.action: he shoulders out through the gap and swings the blade once more to knock the last hanging shards aside, ice dust rolling off his back
beats_en.cn: **他挤出缺口，再补一刀磕开最后几片悬冰**，冰雾从背上翻下来

beats_en.action: the ring draws light inward until it goes white and throws out a lance of blue-white light as thick as one of the columns, its tail of flame filling the frame behind it
beats_en.cn: 升起跟拍｜**贯月光矛**：银环吸光到发白，射出粗如石柱的青白光矛，尾焰拖满画面

beats_en.action: he plants the sword point and a seam of white-cored red light splits the floor and races out to meet it, throwing whole slabs of flagstone up into the air along its path
beats_en.cn: **地裂**：剑插地，白热核红光沟壑从这头裂到那头，整块石板被掀上天

beats_en.action: the two forces meet at the centre of the hall and blow apart, hurling rubble to the ceiling; she plants the staff and braces behind it while he throws his forearm up across his face, and a boy pressed against a column with a clasped book passes through the edge of frame as the blast light washes over him
beats_en.cn: 正面对撞爆开、碎石掀到穹顶｜**她顿杖撑住、他抬臂挡脸**｜凯尔抱书贴柱被爆光扫过

beats_en.action: she sweeps the staff in a circle overhead and three hexagonal sigils each as wide as the hall stack up on the floor around him, and three columns of light slam down in sequence as he breaks sideways into a run
beats_en.cn: **她抡杖过顶起阵** → 三个铺满大殿的法阵叠起、三道光柱砸落｜**他侧身起跑**
beats_en.move: still the same flight, the camera tilts up to the domed ceiling and weaves back down between the falling shafts alongside him
beats_en.size: a moving shot that stays with the fight

beats_en.action: he rolls past the first and cuts two more crescents that carve clean through the second and third shafts and scatter them into falling sparks
beats_en.cn: 侧滚避第一道｜剑气斩 ×2 削断第二、三道光柱，碎成落火

beats_en.action: he strides out of the far side of the shafts, whips the blade around into a low guard and drags the tip across the stone so sparks rake up behind him, the craters still burning at his back
beats_en.cn: **他大步走出光柱、反手把剑抡到低位架起、剑尖犁地拉出火星**，身后弹坑还在烧

beats_en.action: crimson floods out past his irises until the whites of his eyes are fully red, the black lines climb to his collarbone, white vapour pours from his mouth and the whole blade turns into a bar of white-hot red light
beats_en.cn: 狠推脸部｜**狂化 H2**：赤红漫满眼球、黑纹爬到锁骨、白雾涌出、整条剑身化为白热红光柱

beats_en.action: he drives the first four of twelve red arcs across the hexagonal lattice while she sets her feet and takes each one on the shaft, every impact going off with a white core and a shockwave ring that lights the whole hall
beats_en.cn: **他劈出十二连斩的前 4 道** ｜**她扎稳下盘、逐记用杖身接**，每记白热核+冲击环照亮全殿

beats_en.action: four more arcs land in the same chain, she spins the staff and deflects two wide, and her heels drag long glowing grooves back across the stone
beats_en.cn: 中 4 道｜**她旋杖挡开 2 记**，鞋跟在石面拖出两条发亮的沟

beats_en.action: he lands the last four arcs together and she drops to one knee behind the shaft as the deep blue hexagonal mesh cracks open from the point of contact
beats_en.cn: **他末 4 道齐落**｜**她单膝跪撑在杖后**，中层深蓝网格从受击点裂开

beats_en.action: he leaps high and lifts the greatsword overhead with both hands, the blade a column of white-hot red light reaching up toward the ceiling with embers streaming around him, and brings it straight down
beats_en.cn: 升起绕背｜**腾空全力落石**：剑是一柱通天白热红光，火星环身上涌
beats_en.move: the same flight finally cranes up behind him, rushes in to the point of contact and pulls back into the hall, where it comes to rest for the first time
beats_en.size: a moving shot that stays with the fight

beats_en.action: she takes it on the horizontal staff with the ring blazing white, the impact blowing a ring of dust and light outward across the whole floor, a single crack opens across the silver-white inner layer, and the two of them hold against each other at the centre of the hall
beats_en.cn: 急推接触点→猛拉停住｜她横杖硬接，冲击波环扫过整个地面，**内层裂一道缝**，两人僵住
